properties.description: The cut that takes a real person's identity out of everything reflow2 serves. Four increments: settling a Decision can record which option won without rewriting the deliberation; a reply carries its payload once on every tool, not only on the one the old test asked; the build's gate list becomes runnable rather than only cross-checked; and reflow2 stops naming a real person in its served surface while Grok finally gets the config file Grok actually reads. The privacy fix is the reason this cut follows v0.65.0 by two days: the identity was in the published binary, so it only leaves the field on a release. The schema stamp did NOT move — node types, edge types and all 66 enum vocabularies diffed field by field against v0.65.0 — so no upgrade note is owed.
properties.name: v0.66.0 release cut (2026-09-21)
